question: Should the canonical namespace be the existing singular `skill` or a new plural `skills`, and what alias and deprecation policy should govern the established root commands?
rationale: Source, release, and history evidence establish that the work remains missing, but the permanent public command shape and upgrade contract require maintainer intent.

options.title: Expand singular `skill`
options.body: Make the existing namespace canonical, add the complete skill lifecycle beneath it, and retain root aliases through a documented deprecation window.

options.title: Introduce plural `skills`
options.body: Create the requested plural namespace and explicitly transition or alias both the existing singular group and root commands.

options.title: Keep the mixed hierarchy
options.body: Retain current invocation paths and treat visual help grouping as the permanent organization.

recommendation.title: Expand singular `skill`
recommendation.body: Make the existing namespace canonical, add the complete skill lifecycle beneath it, and retain root aliases through a documented deprecation window.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick combines recent CLI release and merge ownership with authorship of this product-direction proposal.
